# Dr Jonathan Renouf

Dr Jonathan Renouf is the current Deputy of [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Dr Jonathan Renouf has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jonathan-renouf#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 2 with 56.8% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/jonathan-renouf/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArN-msp-qwQ)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220520114714/https://jonathanrenouf.je/manifesto/)
  - [2022 St Brelade Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220519103458/https://jonathanrenouf.je/st-brelade/)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Jonathan-Renouf-Deputy-St-Brelade-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=16)

Dr Jonathan Renouf has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2). \[[x.com](https://x.com/JonathanRenouf/status/2032747505658499231)\]
